entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are so steadfast in the principles of your alignment, even magic has difficult swaying you.

Prerequisite(s): Iron Will, Unimpeachable Honor, lawful alignment.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are under the effect of a charm or compulsion effect cast by or coming from a source with a chaotic alignment or an alignment on the good and evil axis opposite of your alignment (evil if you are good, and good if you are evil) you gain a +2 on any saving throw or opposed Charisma check to break free from the effect. This bonus stacks with itself and with the bonus granted by Unimpeachable Honor.
